schemaNote: Atlassian publishes tool names and descriptions but NOT the raw inputSchema JSON that an MCP client loads into context. Unauthenticated tools/list was attempted on 2026-08-05 and returned HTTP 401 invalid_token, so the real schema payload could not be captured. Token figures computed from this file are therefore a LOWER BOUND on the real context cost of the MCP surface.
outOfScope: The server also exposes Jira Service Management, Bitbucket Cloud, Compass, and Teamwork Graph tool groups; they are outside this benchmark's Jira/Confluence scope and are not counted.
